captions.detailed: A modern telescoping desk lamp featuring a heavy, black rectangular base with rounded corners. The vertical post consists of three nested, cylindrical stages in metallic silver, fitted with black collar rings. Extending from the top of the post is a two-part black articulated arm connected by a central elbow joint, leading to a conical, light gray lamp shade. The telescoping post moves vertically, while the arm sections and the shade articulate via rotational hinges.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a telescoping gooseneck desk lamp. The lamp should feature a heavy rectangular base, a three-stage telescoping vertical post with interlocking collars, a dual-link articulated arm connected by rotational elbow joints, and a conical shade at the tip that can tilt.
captions.factory: The code constructs an ArticulatedObject starting with a rectangular Box base. It builds a three-stage telescoping vertical post using nested Cylinder primitives of decreasing radii, each capped with a collar Cylinder. The arm links are modeled as thin cylinders joined by blocky revolute hinge joints. The lamp shade is constructed as a hollowed conical shape. Prismatic joints are defined between the telescoping post segments, while revolute joints are placed at the base of the arm, the elbow, and the shade attachment point.
